hypothesis: Strict PIT positive 7d EPS revision rows may have better forward returns when residual strength is neutral or beta-lagging, while residual-leader status may indicate extension/overheating instead of confirmation.
interpretation: This tests whether residual leadership should be treated as an overextension/risk-state modifier for positive EPS revision rows. It does not promote live logic.
